steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: Huh...? By the way, do you know where all the people went?

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: That Enfer said there are many people here, but I haven't seen any other living person!

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Presume. The visitors, have turned into Corruptors.

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: Ahhhhh... No way?!

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Joke, that was. There's no trace, of any humans here.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: They must be trapped somewhere... Or, like Ambrosia... they are unconscious.

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: Huh? The drink that used to be all the rage in Eastside? I remember it just disappeared one day. What was up with that?
As if finding something valuable, Sasha excitedly approaches the two Sinners.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...No, no, it's not something you should know.

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: Tsk, boring. You Sinners, can't you tell me something interesting...? Nothing I've filmed so far is viral material...

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: And... Are we going the wrong way again?
Looking at the familiar dead end, the livestreamer voices her doubts.

steps.speaker: His breath hitches, then turns to ragged panting. With a surge of fury, he hurls the papers aside, seizes Jabara by the collar, and hauls him violently to his feet.
steps.content: Answer, yes. And this is the 12th time.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...My ability is disturbed, and even the Nightmare can't see the real path.
The spiral corridor is like an endless maze, trapping the group in this section. And the howling of Corruptors is still messing with Hecate's thoughts.
Even with the navigator, the team still struggles to move through the museum.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Proposal. How about letting the excellent tool, Labyrinth, lead the way?

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: At least, it won't make everyone, so anxious.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I'll trust the <color=#fb9259>robot</color> once, but only this once.
Hecate backs down. Finding the Chief is her most important goal, after all.

steps.speaker: Wait, wait! Let me explain! These are old, I swear! Nothing since that day! My dealings with DisCity ended then, I promise!
steps.content: No, you should trust <color=#fb9259>tools</color>.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: A tool has no feelings and will not be swayed by emotional thinking. We only follow... data.
With that, the team comes to a fork in the road again.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Analyzing. In the previous 12 attempts, a pattern is suspected for this type of fork in the road.
Data streams flow through Labyrinth's pupils, showing her calculating.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: There is an 83.3% probability of meeting a dead end on the side with the marker, and... the marker seems to be luring people in.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: So, the side without the marker should be chosen.
Completing her analysis, Labyrinth starts to stride forward.

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: Woah! You are right!

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Proud. As a tool, Labyrinth, is more outstanding.

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: But what the hell is going on with these monsters... Ahhhh!
The situation inside the museum is too complicated. Even with Labyrinth's calculations, they still inevitably run into monsters.
